title: CoatFusion: Controllable Material Coating in Images
abstract: arXiv:2512.02143v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Material Coating, a novel image editing task that simulates applying a thin material layer onto an object while preserving its underlying coarse and fine geometry. Material coating is fundamentally different from existing "material transfer" methods, which are designed to replace an object's intrinsic material, often overwriting fine details. To address this new task, we construct a large-scale synthetic dataset (110K images) of 3D objects with varied, physically-based coatings, named DataCoat110K. We then propose CoatFusion, a novel architecture that enables this task by conditioning a diffusion model on both a 2D albedo texture and granular, PBR-style parametric controls, including roughness, metalness, transmission, and a key thickness parameter. translated_title: CoatFusion：图像中可控的材质涂覆
translated_abstract: 我们提出“材质涂覆”这一新颖的图像编辑任务，旨在模拟在物体表面施加一层薄薄的材质，同时保留其底层的粗粒度和细粒度几何结构。材质涂覆与现有的“材质迁移”方法有本质区别，后者旨在替换物体的固有材质，往往会覆盖细节。为解决这一新任务，我们构建了一个大规模合成数据集DataCoat110K（包含11万张图像），其中包含具有多种基于物理的涂层的3D物体。随后，我们提出了CoatFusion，这是一种新颖的架构，通过将扩散模型条件化于2D反照率纹理以及细粒度的PBR风格参数控制（包括粗糙度、金属度、透射率以及一个关键的厚度参数）来实现该任务。实验和用户研究表明，CoatFusion能够生成逼真且可控的涂覆效果，在各项指标上显著优于现有的材质编辑与迁移方法。
tldr: 提出了一种新的“材质涂覆”图像编辑任务及CoatFusion架构，通过扩散模型结合2D反照率纹理和PBR风格参数控制，实现了保留物体几何细节的逼真且可控的材质涂覆效果。
en_tdlr: CoatFusion introduces a novel "Material Coating" image editing task and a diffusion-based architecture conditioned on 2D albedo textures and PBR-style parametric controls, enabling realistic and controllable material coating that preserves underlying object geometry.
